text:
Elena (CFO): thanks for the great Qs today — looping back on runway / spend controls.
Priya (Sales): quick — runway number? heard both 14 and 18.
Elena (CFO): base runway = 16 months under current bookings. downside stress case = 9-11 months if churn + slower close rates.
Diego (Eng): allocation for infra growth this quarter?
Elena (CFO): we carved a small central infra pool (~$1.2M) for customer-critical capacity and model pilots; any draw requires the new procurement form + justification.
Marta (Hiring): headcount hold? what about offers in flight?
Elena (CFO): offers: only mission-critical proceed. Hiring committee will publish a one-page prioritization rubric by EOD Friday.
Asha (FinanceOps): procurement thresholds updated: < $25k = owner sign-off; $25k-$150k = owner + finance manager; > $150k = director + CFO review. Multi-year prepaids flagged.
Diego (Eng): prepaids for 3yr reserved GPUs — any path to approve quickly?
Elena (CFO): mark as "customer-critical" or "strategic" and attach a one-page ROI + utilization plan. We'll triage within 48 hours with Sales and Solutions.
Priya (Sales): are discount caps changing for enterprise deals?
Sam (CEO): discount bands tightened; Sales ops will publish new playbook tomorrow. No across-the-board price increases planned.
BudgetBot: automated — "Infra initiative: target 12% run-rate reduction in 90 days via batching, caching, spot instances, and quantization."
Diego (Eng): can Eng get per-route cost visibility to inform tradeoffs?
Elena (CFO): yes — Console will expose per-route token cost and latency next sprint; product/eng owners can request early access.
Marta (Hiring): will there be exceptions for mission hires?
Elena (CFO): yes — exceptions via hiring committee + CFO sign-off.
Asha (FinanceOps): action items: procurement form link in #finance, approval matrix updated, hiring rubric coming. Weekly office hours for infra budgets set up.
Sam (CEO): thanks — overall message: keep building, be intentional with spend, escalate customer-critical needs.
Elena (CFO): will post a short FAQ and the doc links here. DM for private items. :thumbsup:
